 Oct 21 (Reuters) - Toyota is recalling 105,794 vehicles in the US over a potential fuel leak that could raise the risk of fire if it reaches an ignition source, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said on Wednesday.
 Here are some details:
 • The recall involves certain 2024-2027 Toyota Land Cruiser Hybrid vehicles, the auto safety regulator said
 • The recall is over issues with the fuel tube connection near the fuel tank, which could disconnect and leak fuel, and increase the risk of a fire, the regulator said
 • As part of the remedy, dealers will install a supplemental clamp or replace the resin fuel tube free of charge, NHTSA said
 (Reporting by Sumedha Mukherjee in Bengaluru; Editing by Subhranshu Sahu)
